## TL;DR

- [Building Pi][1] with Mario Zechner and Armin Ronacher
- [Designing Data-Intensive Applications][2] with Martin Kleppmann
- Building [OpenCode][3] with Dax Raad

## Building Pi

I really liked this episode from the [Pragmatic Engineer Podcast][9]. Mario's approach to building a simple, stable and reliable coding agent is a very welcome breath of fresh air in the overhyped AI coding tools landscape.

## Designing Data-Intensive Applications

[Martin Kleppmann's][4] book [Designing Data-Intensive Applications][5] is considered a classic in software development literature. I personally own a copy and am currently reading through it. While it was great to hear that Martin has published the [second edition][6] of the book, his thoughts regarding [local-first software][7] really caught my interest. If you want to find out more about the local-first concept, check out [Cult Repo's][8] mini documentation:

{{< video https://www.youtube.com/embed/10d8HxS4y_g?si=l-4vDyz24h9x_r_H >}}

## Building OpenCode

A great look behind the scenes of developing OpenCode, combined with a realistic take on using AI for software development.
